text:
Tasha (PM): kicking off rollout plan for 'adaptive-session-v1'. scope: NA opt-in alpha -> EU shadow -> APAC gated. need clear gates, per-tenant opt-out, and audit trail.
Eli (Eng): plan = shadow EU 24h @10%, NA visible opt-in 5% -> 25% if gates pass. A/B: baseline vs adaptive-session-v1. add synthetic 1% holdback cohort.
Rina (SRE): canary pool: reserve 2 warm GPUs in eu-west. alarms: 5xx>0.5% OR p99>350ms for 10m -> auto-decrease or rollback. fallback sequence: try quantized fallback for 3m then baseline.
Noel (Data): metrics: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, token cost delta, automated quality delta on seeded eval. target ~10k requests/arm for 1.5% detection. I'll wire dashboards.
Tasha (PM): launch gates: smoke at 5% (no alarms, quality delta <=1.5%), manual check at 25%, full roll with sign-off. enterprise must have pre-approval flag to opt into visible cohorts.
Eli (Eng): flag proto to ops (small snippet):
```json
{"flag":"adaptive_session_v1","mode":"opt_in","variants":["baseline","v1"],"shadow":{"EU":0.10},"holdback":0.01}
```
Rina (SRE): add per-tenant kill switch + audit log entry on overrides. also enforce tenant blackout windows so scheduled maint tenants are excluded from visible splits.
ops-bot: scheduled shadow_start: 2026-07-02T03:00Z, visible_na_start: 2026-07-05T16:00Z
Eli (Eng): infra TODOS: implement flag schema, shadow routing, holdback cohort, runtime fallback hooks.
Rina (SRE): SRE TODOS: reserve pool, alarm rules, per-tenant audit + blackout enforcement, pre-canary 20m ops review.
Noel (Data): DATA TODOS: dashboard panels, eval harness, sampling queries. will deliver dashboard by EOD Mon.
Tasha (PM): comms/runbook: I'll draft tenant notes, rollback FAQ, and post runbook in #launchroom after infra PRs merge. blockers? :eyes:
Eli (Eng): CI for rollout controller must be green by 2026-07-03.
Rina (SRE): will block if canary pool not reserved.
Tasha (PM): great, tagging @Eli @Rina for follow-up. thanks!
